wiki_article: One Transcript, Whole Stack: Computation Record (deposit #1479, 15 August 2026) is a technical report carrying the computation record for a full-stack measurement of a single semantic rent event in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's instrument suite. The deposit documents each instrument's per-transcript outputs and the reconciliation step across instruments, with discrepancies recorded rather than smoothed, so that the stack's behavior on one concrete case is auditable end to end. Its archival history is itself part of its record: the deposit was partially lost from the registry at some point after minting — its registry entry, canonical text file, record page and PDF disappeared while its download alias survived — and it was restored on 22 August 2026 from that alias during the EA-CORPORA-02 session, with the AXN recomposed from the restored canonical bytes through the archive's single derivation path. The restoration healed the registry's contiguity (AXN-004) and is noted in the deposit's modifications trail.
